parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the whitelist group.

parameters.name: ModifyMode
parameters.description:
The modification mode. Valid values:

- 0: overwrite
- 1: increase
- 2: delete

> Specify 0 to use the overwrite mode.

parameters.name: SecurityIPList
parameters.description: The IP addresses to add to the instance whitelist. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). For example, 192.168.0.0/24 indicates that all IP addresses in the 192.168.0.XX range are allowed to access the instance.
